parameters.text: =Workers Teleported to task location and tasks assigned.

combatPlan.safetyNotes: Avoid the iron golem's powerful attacks by keeping a safe distance.
combatPlan.combatRequest: Deploy two soldiers to collaboratively fight the iron golem.
combatPlan.tacticalsummary: Two soldiers will work together to defeat the iron golem, using a tank and flanker approach.
combatPlan.failureCondition: Iron golem escapes or soldiers' health critical.

constraints: Keep at least 3 blocks from Soldier2.
Regroup if target moves out of range.
soldierInstructions.instructionText: Equip your best sword or axe and engage the iron golem directly from the front. Maintain aggro and attack for up to 60 seconds. Retreat if your health drops below 6 hearts or if the golem moves beyond 30 blocks.

soldierInstructions.tactic: Delay and flank after Soldier1 engages.
soldierInstructions.objective: Flank the iron golem to maximize damage.
constraints: Regroup if target moves out of range.
soldierInstructions.instructionText: Wait 1.5 seconds, then equip your best sword or axe. Flank the iron golem from the opposite side of Soldier1 and attack. Stay engaged for up to 60 seconds. Retreat if health drops below 6 hearts or if the golem moves beyond 30 blocks.

battlefieldAssessment.recommendations: Maintain distance to avoid area damage.
